entities.summary: Gwanggaeto, a notable figure in the history of North Korea, associated with Goguryeo Kingdom (37 BCE–413). Preceded by Goguryeo Rise and Expansion. Their legacy influenced Goguryeo-Sui/Tang Wars and Fall and Tang.
